newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: New Zealand dollar ends stronger but off peak.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand dollar ends stronger but off peak.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar ended slightly stronger but off its peak on Friday, with US$0.7000 seen as a base and resistance expected to kick in at 0.7050.
The Kiwi finished at US$0.7033/40 from 0.7025/32 at the open, having traded a 0.7028-45 range on the day.
The Trade-Weighted Index ended a touch weaker at 68.89 from 68.94.
Dealers expect a slow sideways drift over the short term, but with buy orders amassing at US$0.7000 and just below.
Support for the Australian dollar was said to have had a rub off effect, but there was little to focus on before Thursday's six-monthly forecasts from the Reserve Bank.
